limitations: 指定2013PILODIST_1041.pdf的Technical Data位于PDF第2页，不是调研表写的第1页；数值一致，页码定位更正。
指定Technical Data最高90理论板；厂家总目录brosch_engl.pdf印刷第8页写最高100板。固定本任务90板版本，100板仅作为冲突记录，不混用。
原文尺寸顺序W×H×D，自动脚手架误当W×D×H；本台模型改为XYZ=[1.60,0.50,2.70]m，不改共享解析器。
PILODIST104HT是真空到1mbar的高熔点定制版，PILODIST105是20L等其他配置；不借用105的柱长/1.5mL滞留/80–100板或HT性能。
当前官网允许单接收器或6×1L蜘蛛收集器；本模型明确选择后者，不误用105的9接收器。
整机照片有外部Julabo循环设施；本资产按提示只声明共享浴/泵边界，不复制外部设备，更不把它们当主机内置泵浴。
DN25是公称连接/柱径，不是已知玻璃壁厚、夹套外径或准确内孔尺寸；所有局部厚度和额定值缺口保留未知。
总外廓、6L釜、装量和额定操作温压来自指定版本；局部尺寸、油浴升降和回流阀/收集选择器行程都是教学几何。
真实整机质量未知，Matterix10kg回退及URDF分件0.1kg/包围盒惯量只作数值代理，不标实测。
两种DN25柱可互换；几何展示一根在位、另一根存放，运行时柱型配置不等于机器人已换柱。
真实理论板数依体系/工况，运行时级数与滞留量需宿主明确输入，默认教学参数不等于厂家标定或90板实测性能。
采用真实NIST蒸气压拟合与理想Raoult平衡级近似；不声称具有实验二元VLE、共沸或非理想活度数据。
有限釜/各级/冷凝器/6接收器库存及回流响应需守恒；热物性、滞留量、传热、回流响应系数缺公共实测值时由宿主显式给定。
DCD4001为PC软件+接口盒，不捏造实体温度/真空旋钮；面板数字区仅教学显示，不复刻原厂Windows图形界面。
厂家的1000mbar工作上限与文字ATM有约1.3%差异；操作目标按10–100000Pa，通气边界可取宿主大气压101325Pa并明确非主动工况。
81 real NIST reference substances,80 with any device pure-boiling overlap; not81 measured distillation runs. Chosen mixtures require every pure component bubble point inside common chosen fit domain.
Ideal activity coefficients and constant molar overflow; no azeotropes, nonideal VLE, entrainment, reaction, decomposition, flooding, pressure drop or thermodynamic energy closure.

Column type is a configuration identifier; effective stages and holdups are explicit host inputs, never inferred from geometry rings or assumed90-stage performance. Both column types need experimental calibration.
Prewetted startup initialization deducts all holdup from sample; actual dry-column wetting, dynamic total holdup and hydraulic transport delays are not resolved.
Bath temperature first-order; boilup coefficient and molar volume are host assumptions. Instantaneous equilibrium-stage temperatures during boiling, no sensible/latent/condenser heat balance.
Pressure target fixed before sample load; pressure transient conditions before boilup. Ideal total condenser has finite liquid holdup, no vapor inventory or thermal-capacity model.
Reference additive volumes at declared sample reference temperature, not temperature-dependent physical density.
Manual bath jack and collector selection animation are host proxies; no robotic manipulation or real DCD4001 graphical firmware. Six optional1L fixed bottles only, not9 receivers.
Reflux plunger shows average fraction; actual valve pulse timing/stroke unknown. Stage-count physical90plate envelope not experimentally validated.
Public session filtering is not deployed file/process isolation. Matterix acknowledgment separate from native asynchronous completion.
